verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API-first BaaS platform. Its documented public API covers customers, accounts, cards, internal transfers, ACH, wires, verification and webhooks. Developers can get a sandbox API key and start calling the APIs straight away. Probes confirm a live OpenAPI spec at docs.synctera.com/openapi.json and an llms.txt index of the v2 docs (668 pages), both of which suit agent-driven use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
